# Maintainer project context

> Auto-generated by Maintainer. Re-run `/maintainer learn` after major code changes.

## Overview

Maintainer is a GitHub Action that automates issue triage and bug-fix drafting for open-source repositories. On every issue event it classifies the issue (type, severity, scope, reproducibility), deduplicates against existing issues, applies labels, and posts a sticky structured comment. When triage marks an issue as a scoped, reproducible bug, it chains into a fix flow that reads the codebase with a tool-using Claude agent, makes a minimal change, runs the project's tests, and opens a draft pull request. It also responds to `/maintainer ...` slash commands and `@maintainer ...` natural-language mentions in issue comments, runs a weekly stale sweep, and (in dashboard mode) aggregates a cross-repo `STATUS.md`. The whole product runs inside one GitHub Actions step plus an optional Supabase telemetry backend and a Next.js dashboard. Audience: open-source maintainers who want unattended first-pass handling of new issues without giving up review control.

## Stack

- Language: TypeScript across the entire monorepo.
- Action runtime: Node 24, packaged as a single CommonJS bundle at `dist/index.js` via `@vercel/ncc`.
- LLM SDK: `@anthropic-ai/sdk` (Claude Sonnet for triage/intent/review, Claude Opus for fix/learn). Prompt-cache control blocks set on system, last tool, and last message.
- GitHub APIs: `@actions/core`, `@actions/github`, `@octokit/rest`, `@octokit/auth-app` (for optional GitHub App identity).
- Config validation: `zod`. Config file format: `js-yaml`.
- Test framework: `vitest` (unit tests only, in `apps/action/test/`).
- Lint: `eslint` 9 with `@typescript-eslint`. Format: `prettier`.
- Dashboard app: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind 3 + `@supabase/supabase-js`.
- Telemetry DB: Supabase Postgres with RLS. Schema in `supabase/migrations/`. Shared types live in `packages/supabase/`.
- Workspace layout: npm workspaces over `apps/*` and `packages/*`. Root `package.json` proxies build/typecheck/lint/test to `@maintainer/action`.

## Directory structure

- `action.yml` - Action manifest. Declares inputs (`anthropic-api-key`, `github-token`, `mode`, `config-path`, `supabase-url`, `supabase-secret-key`, `app-id`, `app-private-key`) and points `main` at `dist/index.js`.
- `dist/` - Built bundle. Committed; CI fails if it drifts from source.
- `apps/action/` - The Action source. Build target `@maintainer/action`.
  - `src/index.ts` - Entry point and event router (issues, issue_comment, schedule, workflow_dispatch).
  - `src/agent/` - LLM client, prompts, tool-use loop, prompt-cache helpers.
  - `src/triage/run.ts` - Triage flow.
  - `src/fix/` - Fix flow, project detection, sandboxed workspace, allow-listed shell tools.
  - `src/review/run.ts` - Reviewer pass over the fixer's diff before opening a PR.
  - `src/commands/` - Slash-command parser, router, intent agent, explain command.
  - `src/context/` - Project-context document loader/generator (this file).
  - `src/dashboard/` - Cross-repo `STATUS.md` aggregation (separate from the Next.js app).
  - `src/schedule/stale.ts`, `src/schedule/digest.ts` - Weekly tasks.
  - `src/github/` - Octokit client, issues, labels, prs, search, GitHub App auth.
  - `src/config/` - YAML loader and Zod schema with defaults.
  - `src/db/` - Supabase telemetry writes (best-effort, never throw upstream).
  - `src/util/` - Logger, sticky-comment helpers, token budget, pricing table, retry, event parsers.
- `apps/action/test/` - Vitest suites for parser, config, render, sticky, pricing, detect, top-level index.
- `apps/dashboard/` - Next.js 16 app: Hero page, repo list, run detail, live activity feed, totals (uses Supabase realtime).
- `apps/orchestrator/` - Currently README only; placeholder for a future hosted orchestrator.
- `packages/supabase/` - Shared client factory and generated `Database` types consumed by both `@maintainer/action` and the dashboard.
- `supabase/migrations/` - Single init migration creating `repos`, `issues`, `runs`, `agent_steps`, `pull_requests` with RLS policies.
- `.github/workflows/` - `test.yml` (CI: typecheck, lint, test, build, dist drift check), `release.yml` (tag-driven major-version tag move + GitHub Release), `maintainer.yml` (self-hosted dogfood).
- `.github/maintainer.yml` - This repo's own Maintainer configuration.
- `docs/` - `dashboard.md`, `github-app.md`. Operator-facing docs.
- `examples/maintainer.yml` - Sample user configuration.
- `tasks/todo.md` - v1 milestones.
- `vercel.json` - Dashboard deploy config.

## Key files

- `apps/action/src/index.ts` - Top-level `run()`. Parses inputs, mints App token if configured, loads config, ensures labels, creates a `runs` row in Supabase, and switches on `context.eventName` to call triage / fix / commands / dashboard / stale flows. Defines `RunState` and `RunOutcome` used by all sub-flows. Always calls `finishRun` in `finally`.
- `apps/action/src/config/schema.ts` - Zod `ConfigSchema`. Single source of truth for default models, token budgets, fix step caps, stale thresholds, dashboard repo list, label prefix, and `skip_label`.
- `apps/action/src/agent/loop.ts` - `runAgent()` (multi-turn tool-use loop) and `callStructured()` (forced single tool call for JSON schema output). Records cache_creation/cache_read tokens into `TokenBudget`, breaks on `budget.exhausted()` or non-tool-use stop_reason.
- `apps/action/src/agent/prompts.ts` - `TRIAGE_PROMPT`, `FIX_PROMPT`, `INTENT_PROMPT`, `REVIEWER_PROMPT`, `LEARN_PROMPT`, `EXPLAIN_PROMPT`. All system prompts live here.
- `apps/action/src/triage/run.ts` - Triage flow. Builds candidate-duplicate list, calls `callStructured` with `TRIAGE_TOOL_SCHEMA`, applies labels (`maintainer:bug`, `maintainer:severity-*`, `maintainer:needs-repro`, `maintainer:duplicate`, `maintainer:needs-human`), upserts the sticky `triage` comment, records `agent_steps` row.
- `apps/action/src/fix/run.ts` - Fix flow orchestrator. Verifies checkout, detects project, loads project context, runs the fixer agent, retries once with a "write_file now" nudge if the agent went text-only, filters changes to `Workspace.writtenPaths`, runs tests, runs the reviewer, commits and pushes, opens or updates a draft PR. The most procedural file in the codebase.
- `apps/action/src/fix/sandbox.ts` - `Workspace` class. Path-traversal-safe FS, child_process spawn with timeout and 200KB stdout truncation, `git status --porcelain` parser, `writtenPaths` set used to scope commits to the agent's intent.
- `apps/action/src/fix/tools.ts` - Tool definitions exposed to the fixer: `list_directory`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `grep`, `run_command` (allow-list of binaries).
- `apps/action/src/commands/router.ts` - Comment dispatcher. Parses slash vs mention, gates on collaborator write permission, manages reactions (eyes/rocket/+1/confused), routes to triage/fix/skip/explain/dedupe/learn/help or to `runIntent`.
- `apps/action/src/db/ops.ts` - All Supabase writes. Functions: `ensureRepo`, `ensureIssue`, `recordTriageVerdict`, `startRun`, `finishRun`, `recordAgentStep`, `recordPullRequest`, `attachPrToRun`, `attachIssueToRun`. Each is wrapped in `safe()` so DB failures only warn.
- `supabase/migrations/20260509215045_init_schema.sql` - Data model: `repos`, `issues` (with triage columns and `duplicates_of int[]`), `runs`, `agent_steps` (UNIQUE (run_id, position)), `pull_requests`. RLS policies tie everything to `repos.installed_by_user`.

## Features

- Issue triage on `issues.opened|reopened|edited` -> `apps/action/src/index.ts:104-150` then `apps/action/src/triage/run.ts:runTriage` (full file).
- Triage label application -> `apps/action/src/triage/run.ts:applyTriageLabels`.
- Triage sticky comment rendering -> `apps/action/src/triage/run.ts:renderTriageBody`.
- Duplicate-candidate search using token-overlap query -> `apps/action/src/github/search.ts:findCandidateDuplicates`.
- Auto-attempt fix when triage flags `fixable && config.fix.auto_attempt && action==='opened'` -> `apps/action/src/index.ts:155-167`.
- Fix flow (read/edit/run tests, draft PR) -> `apps/action/src/fix/run.ts:runFix` (full file). Scope-to-intent staging at `commitAndPush`.
- Project type detection (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun, pytest, cargo, go, ruby, maven, gradle) -> `apps/action/src/fix/detect.ts:detectProject`.
- Reviewer agent gating PRs -> `apps/action/src/review/run.ts:runReview`. Block-on-reject controlled by `config.review.block_on_reject`.
- Slash commands `/maintainer triage|fix|skip|explain|dedupe|learn|help` -> `apps/action/src/commands/router.ts:handleSlash`.
- Free-form `@maintainer` mentions -> `apps/action/src/commands/intent.ts:runIntent` (tools: post_comment, apply_labels, remove_label, close_issue, reopen_issue, request_fix, request_triage).
- Explain a noisy issue in plain language -> `apps/action/src/commands/explain.ts:runExplain`.
- Project-context generator (`/maintainer learn`) -> `apps/action/src/context/generate.ts:runLearn`. Writes `.github/maintainer-context.md` and opens a draft PR on branch `maintainer/learn`.
- Project-context loader fed into fix and intent prompts -> `apps/action/src/context/load.ts:loadProjectContext`.
- Stale issue sweep (label then close) -> `apps/action/src/schedule/stale.ts:runStale`.
- Cross-repo dashboard `STATUS.md` and weekly briefing issue -> `apps/action/src/dashboard/run.ts:runDashboard` and `apps/action/src/dashboard/render.ts:renderStatus`.
- Standard label set creation on first run -> `apps/action/src/github/labels.ts:standardLabels`, `ensureLabels`.
- Sticky comment per flow (`triage`, `fix`, `intent`, `dashboard`) -> `apps/action/src/util/sticky.ts:findStickyComment`, `withStickyMarker`, plus `apps/action/src/github/issues.ts:upsertStickyComment`.
- Run footer with cost/tokens/runtime on every comment -> `apps/action/src/util/sticky.ts:renderRunFooter`.
- Token budget with cache-aware accounting -> `apps/action/src/util/budget.ts:TokenBudget` (cache writes 1.25x, cache reads 0.1x).
- Cost estimate per model -> `apps/action/src/util/pricing.ts:PRICES`, `estimateCost`.
- GitHub App identity (custom comment author) -> `apps/action/src/github/app-auth.ts:mintInstallationToken` plus the `app-id`/`app-private-key` block in `apps/action/src/index.ts:43-58`.
- Supabase telemetry (every step, run, PR) -> `apps/action/src/db/ops.ts` (all exports).
- Live dashboard UI -> `apps/dashboard/app/page.tsx` (homepage), `apps/dashboard/app/runs/[id]/page.tsx`, `apps/dashboard/app/components/*`.

## Conventions

- ESM-style imports with explicit `.js` extensions even for TypeScript files (`from './x.js'`). Required because `apps/action/tsconfig.json` targets node ESM resolution; do not drop the extension.
- All log output goes through `apps/action/src/util/log.ts`, which wraps `@actions/core`. Never `console.log`.
- Errors in best-effort paths (Supabase writes, reactions, label removal of a non-existent label, PR labeling) are caught and downgraded to `log.warn`; only fatal errors call `core.setFailed`. The Action must keep going when telemetry or auxiliary calls fail.
- DB writes go through the `safe()` wrapper in `apps/action/src/db/ops.ts`. They return `null` on failure. Every caller already null-checks; preserve that.
- Sticky comments are identified by an HTML comment marker `<!-- maintainer:state:<flow> -->` on the first line. There is exactly one comment per `(issue, flow)` pair. Use `upsertStickyComment`, never `postComment`, for triage/fix/intent/dashboard updates.
- Reactions signal lifecycle: `eyes` on receipt, `rocket` when work begins, `+1` on success, `confused` on failure. Set them via `reactToIssue` / `reactToComment`.
- Draft PRs only. Maintainer never marks a PR ready or merges. Every fix PR gets `maintainer:needs-human-review`.
- Issues are never auto-closed except when a user explicitly tells the intent agent or via a `Fixes #N` PR merge by GitHub itself.
- Label prefix is configurable (`config.labels.prefix`, default `maintainer:`). Do not hardcode `maintainer:` in new code; read it from config.
- `config.skip_label` (default `maintainer:skip`) short-circuits all automation on an issue.
- The fix agent's `Workspace.writtenPaths` is the source of truth for "what the agent intended to change". Anything that lands in `git status` but not in `writtenPaths` (lockfile mutations from `npm install`, build artifacts) is filtered out before the diff is fed to the reviewer and before the commit is staged. Preserve this when extending the fix flow.
- The fixer is told via prompt that text-only turns are not allowed before the fix is on disk. The flow has a built-in single retry "nudge" when the agent stops without writing files (`apps/action/src/fix/run.ts` lines around the `nudge` MessageParam). Keep that retry logic if you refactor the loop.
- Allow-list of shell binaries lives in `apps/action/src/fix/tools.ts:ALLOWED_BINARIES`. Adding a new tool requires adding it there or `run_command` returns an error string. Never bypass the allow-list.
- `Workspace.resolveSafe` rejects paths that escape the repo root. All FS access must go through `Workspace`, not raw `fs`.
- Models are referenced by string IDs (`claude-sonnet-4-6`, `claude-opus-4-7`, `claude-haiku-4-5`). When adding a model, add it to `apps/action/src/util/pricing.ts:PRICES` so cost estimation works.
- Prompt caching: `systemWithCache`, `toolsWithCache`, `messagesWithRollingCache` in `apps/action/src/agent/cache.ts` mark the system prompt, last tool, and last message with `cache_control: ephemeral`. Do not move cache markers without checking the budget math.
- Outputs are deterministic-ish; structured outputs use `tool_choice: { type: 'tool', name }` with a Zod-shaped JSON schema (see `TRIAGE_TOOL_SCHEMA`, `REVIEW_TOOL_SCHEMA`).
- Comment author detection: `apps/action/src/github/client.ts:isBotAuthor` filters logins ending in `[bot]`. The router uses this to avoid command loops.
- Adding a new slash command: extend `parseCommand` regex if needed, add a case in `handleSlash`, update `helpText`, update README. Add a Vitest case in `apps/action/test/parse.test.ts`.
- Adding a new agent: define a string in the `agent_steps.agent` CHECK constraint (`supabase/migrations/...`), update the `AgentName` union in `apps/action/src/db/ops.ts`, and the dashboard's filters in `apps/dashboard/`.
- Adding a new config option: update `apps/action/src/config/schema.ts` with a Zod default, the README's config block, and `examples/maintainer.yml`. Tests in `apps/action/test/config.test.ts`.
- Bundle drift: `dist/index.js` is committed. After any source change run `npm run build` and commit `dist/`. CI (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) hard-fails on drift.
- Comments in code: keep them rare and explain why, not what. The fixer prompt explicitly forbids narrative comments. Match this style when editing.
- No emojis anywhere (UI, comments, prompts, README). The product voice is neutral and professional; reviewers reject emoji additions.

## Test and verification

- Unit tests: `npm test` from repo root, which delegates to `vitest run` in `apps/action`. Suites cover the slash parser, config schema, project detection, sticky-comment marker handling, pricing math, run footer rendering, and the top-level index. There are no integration tests against live GitHub or Anthropic; mock at the function boundary.
- Typecheck: `npm run typecheck` (root) -> `tsc --noEmit` for `@maintainer/action`. Dashboard typechecks via its own `npm run typecheck` if needed.
- Lint: `npm run lint` (root) -> `eslint src --ext .ts` in `apps/action`. Config in `apps/action/eslint.config.mjs`.
- Format: `npm run format` runs Prettier on `apps/**/src/**/*.ts`.
- Build: `npm run build` -> `ncc build src/index.ts -o ../../dist`. Output committed.
- Composite check: `npm run all` runs typecheck, lint, test, build in order. CI runs this plus a `git status --porcelain dist/` check.
- Manual end-to-end verification: open or edit an issue in a repo that has a `.github/workflows/maintainer.yml` calling `ugurkocde/Maintainer@v1`, confirm the eyes reaction appears within seconds, the triage sticky comment posts within ~30s, and (for fixable bugs) a draft PR opens labeled `maintainer:needs-human-review`. The Action's own logs in the GitHub Actions UI show every agent step, token count, and stop reason via `log.info`.
- Database verification (when Supabase configured): rows appear in `runs`, `agent_steps`, `issues`, `pull_requests`. The dashboard at `apps/dashboard/` reads from these and is the easiest place to confirm telemetry shape.
- Release verification: tag `vX.Y.Z` triggers `.github/workflows/release.yml`, which re-runs `npm run all`, force-moves the major tag (`v1`), and creates a GitHub Release.
